Impact

Material recovered,and how we know.

Impact here means tonnes of PET and aluminium that went back into material rather than to landfill, counted per container at the machine. Every figure below states its unit and the period it covers. Anything not yet measured shows as a dash rather than as a number.

02 Market structure

Where Egypt’s PET actually goes.

The gap this business addresses is not between consumption and recycling — it is between consumption and formal recovery. Informal collectors already recover a large share, and leaving them out of the picture would overstate the problem and misrepresent the market.

PET formally collected — no source
PET informally collected — no source
PET uncollected — no source

Chart not drawn — no public source

The structure of the flow is shown, but not the proportions. Drawing magnitudes without a public source for every band would produce a chart that reads as authoritative and is not. Each band needs a figure from the same study and the same year — mixing sources is how a flow chart ends up looking right and being wrong.

03 Method

How we calculate recovered tonnage.

Short version: we count containers, not bags. Tonnage is derived from counted containers and weighed collections, and the two are reconciled.

01

Count at the point of acceptance

Every accepted container is counted by the machine at the moment it is validated, by material stream. Rejected containers are not counted. This is a count of objects, not an estimate from volume.

02

Weigh at collection

Each collection is weighed by stream when it leaves the site. That gives an actual mass, independent of the container count.

03

Reconcile the two

Counted containers multiplied by the average container mass for that stream should agree with the weighed mass. Where they diverge, the weighed mass is authoritative and the average mass is corrected — not the other way round.

04

Report the weighed figure

Published tonnage is weighed mass, not modelled mass. Contamination and moisture are part of the weighed figure until material is sorted at the processing centre, so the reported figure is conservative rather than flattering.

04 Exclusions

What is deliberately excluded.

ExcludedNo avoided-emissions figure is published without a stated methodology and a source. A CO₂e number is a calculation, not a measurement, and it inherits every assumption behind it.

ExcludedNo claim is made about material that leaves our custody. We report what we recovered and sold, not what a reprocessor ultimately did with it.

ExcludedContainers rejected by the machine are excluded entirely, even though a depositor carried them in.
